methodology: PE computed from ETF Price * Payout_Ratio / Trailing_12M_Dividends. Pipeline: scale anchor on live PE → clip [3,100] → 3-month rolling median → re-anchor. Both raw (pe_raw) and smoothed (pe) series exposed. Series with >15% clipped points are voided. Limitation: dividend-based reconstruction overstates PE for low-payout markets (US tech) and understates for high-payout markets (European utilities). Real EPS data requires paid feeds.
